recommended_phases.title: Phase 1: Domain Primitives — leave-type & leave-status
recommended_phases.rationale: Zero-dependency leaf modules. Define the LeaveType enum (annual, sick, emergency) and LeaveStatus enum (pending, approved, rejected, cancelled). These are referenced by every other module in the slice.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 2: Audit & Notification infrastructure
recommended_phases.rationale: Leaf modules with no domain dependencies. Audit-log satisfies GP-002 (all state-changing ops write audit records). Notification handles manager/employee alerts. Both are consumed by leave-request in Phase 4.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 3: Policy & Balance services
recommended_phases.rationale: Both depend only on leave-type (Phase 1). Leave-policy defines max-days and accrual rules per leave type per fiscal year. Balance tracks per-employee remaining days, with deduct/credit operations. Both are consumed by leave-request.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 4: Leave-request — orchestration & API surface
recommended_phases.rationale: Depends on all prior phases. Orchestrates apply/approve/reject/cancel workflows: validates against policy, checks/deducts balance, writes audit records, fires notifications. Exposes Fastify routes with RBAC guards. This is the only module with a controller and routes.

app_notes:
## Layer boundaries

- **Domain primitives** (innermost): `leave-type`, `leave-status` — pure enums/models, zero dependencies
- **Domain services**: `leave-policy`, `balance` — business rules, repository-backed, depend only on primitives
- **Infrastructure**: `audit-log`, `notification` — cross-cutting, no domain dependencies
- **Application orchestration** (outermost): `leave-request` — controller + routes, depends on all inner layers, the only module with an HTTP surface

## Dependency direction (verified acyclic)

```
leave-type  ←  leave-policy  ←  leave-request
leave-type  ←  balance       ←  leave-request
leave-status ←                ←  leave-request
                                leave-request → audit-log
                                leave-request → notification
```

## Golden Principles alignment

- **GP-001 (Repository pattern)**: `leave-policy`, `balance`, `leave-request`, and `audit-log` each declare a repository interface; services depend on interfaces, not on concrete DB access
- **GP-002 (Audit records)**: `leave-request` service calls `IAuditService.record()` on every state-changing operation (apply, approve, reject, cancel)
- **GP-003 (Input validation)**: `LeaveRequestController` validates all inputs at the Fastify route boundary before delegating to the service
- **GP-005 (RBAC enforcement)**: Routes are registered with role guards — `apply` requires employee role, `approve`/`reject` require manager role
- **GP-006 (Error handling)**: All async service methods are wrapped; controller catches and maps errors to Fastify error responses
